events.summary: A trial in South Korea shocked residents after a staff member sexually abused a disabled care home resident.
AWS CEO warned that rapid AI growth could pose risks to U.S. stocks and the broader economy.
Polls indicate Brazil's President Lula's lead over former President Bolsonaro is narrowing, with no candidate likely to win outright in the upcoming election.
Procter & Gamble prepares to report Q4 earnings for October.
Microsoft's stock and secure cloud offerings were highlighted in a US national security trade discussion.
A Russian drone struck Kyiv's Pivnichyi (Northern) Bridge as German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visited Ukraine's capital.
Yemeni government forces and Houthis intensified fighting in Taiz governorate over strategic locations.
A magnitude‑5 earthquake struck 37 km north of Ruteng, Indonesia.
A magnitude‑2.9 earthquake occurred 41 km NNE of Ambler, Alaska.
Bosnian Serb leader Milorad Dodik said Bosnia is ‘dead’, raising concerns ahead of the country’s high‑stakes elections.
USGS reports a magnitude 4.6 earthquake 110 km south of Dampit, Indonesia.
Visa shares fell about 6% as analysts evaluate how Britain’s new payment‑rails will affect the company’s stock outlook through 2030.
A forest fire started in the Democratic Republic of Congo on 1 October 2026 and continued until 3 October 2026.
Magnitude 3.25 earthquake occurred 64 km NNE of Cruz Bay, U.S. Virgin Islands.
A magnitude 4.9 earthquake struck 21 km northeast of Lae, Papua New Guinea.
The Milwaukee Framework proposes new trade pricing measures to reduce excess steel capacity in the United States.
A magnitude 5.0 earthquake occurred 295 km south of Burica, Panama.
A forest fire started in Australia on 30 September 2026 and continued until 3 October 2026.
The Motley Fool recommends two of the Magnificent Seven stocks as long‑term buys.
A magnitude 4.3 earthquake occurred 5 km south‑southwest of Zonianá, Greece, according to USGS.
The US redeployed B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in the UK due to Iran-related security concerns.
Yemeni government forces launch major combat operation to retake territory held by Houthi rebels, declaring a "battle for liberation".
US Coast Guard suspends search for six missing on medical jet that disappeared between Bermuda and Boston; debris found off Nantucket.
Tropical Depression KOGUMA-26 reached max winds 194 km/h in the Northwest Pacific on 5 Oct 2026; no population was reported affected.
Kitco provides the live price of rhodium in Canadian dollars.
In Brazil's presidential first round, Flavio Bolsonaro outperformed expectations, setting a runoff with Lula for 25 Oct.
A forest fire ignited in Ethiopia on 4 Oct 2026, lasting that day.
Brazil's presidential election heads to a runoff as Bolsonaro and Lula both fail to secure majority.
The Ku Klux Klan is attempting to rebrand as the 'Knights Party' to attract new members in the United States.
Samoa's prime minister apologized after a 2007 video surfaced showing him giving a Nazi salute.
Thousands of supporters of jailed former Pakistani prime minister Imran Khan marched in Islamabad after negotiations with authorities stalled.
France suspends classes in up to 500 schools amid student protests and clashes with riot police.
Top 50 mining firms suffer $264B loss as gold prices fall and lithium stocks retreat.
German Green Steel announced its IPO listing on 5 Oct 2026, detailing expected price and debut.
Ireland and Israel played to a 1-1 draw in a Nations League match on 5 Oct 2026.
China's Zhang Zhanshuo and Yu Zidi dominated the Asian Games, winning multiple gold medals.
Yemen's government launches a major offensive against the Houthis, while Iran says it will defend itself against any US attack.
Caterpillar announced a $1 billion expansion of its North Carolina facilities, boosting local employment and production capacity.
A magnitude 5 earthquake struck 71 km east of ‘Ohonua, Tonga, as reported by USGS.
The Wall Street Journal reports rising gasoline, diesel, and electricity prices are influencing American voters.
A magnitude 4.2 earthquake occurred 111 km south of Dampit, Indonesia on 5 Oct 2026.
Millions of Brazilians voted in the first round of the presidential election.
A 4.5 magnitude earthquake struck the Kuril Islands.
A forest fire started in Angola on 30 Sep 2026 and continued until 4 Oct 2026.
USGS recorded a magnitude 5.3 earthquake at the central Mid‑Atlantic Ridge, an offshore seismic event.
Boeing secured a $20 billion contract to supply new fighter aircraft, marking its largest defense deal to date.
A forest fire burned in Sudan from 2 Oct to 4 Oct 2026.
Egypt, Eritrea, Somalia and Sudan leaders issue a joint declaration urging talks to end Sudan's civil war as fighting in Ethiopia intensifies.
Brazilian presidential election moves to run‑off on 25 Oct after Flávio Bolsonaro fails to secure majority in first round.

Oil exports from the Middle East have exceeded pre-war levels despite tensions, with negligible flows through US‑supervised Hormuz routes.

Gold prices resumed upward momentum, signaling a return to bull market conditions, with attention on related gold stocks.

USGS reported a magnitude 4.4 earthquake located 12 km north of Villa El Carmen, Nicaragua.
